activation_method: steam activation at 800 C for 1 h (steam 10 g/min) under N2 100 mL/min, heated at 5 C/min (same furnace step as carbonization)
functional_groups: C-O, C=O, C-OOH, carbonate/CO/CO2 species (XPS C1s, Table 1); N1s: nitride or aromatic amine, imide, pyridine-N-oxide; O1s: hydroxyl, amide carbonyl O, carboxyl (Fig. 2c,d; sample not specified)
source_location: main p. 9761 (main-07.png), Fig. 4a (77 K, 0-1 bar), series WC-ACHF-0.5% (violet markers)
notes: archive: HYC-0043_fig4a_WC-ACHF-0.5.json. Marker centroid from digitize_figure.py markers mode on a copy of the page image with legend and inset whitened. isotherm_point_count counts the 19 markers visible from about 0.38 bar; markers below that are hidden under the WC-ACHF-2.0% and WC-ACHF-3.0% series (the fully visible WC-ACHF-3.0% series has 29), and 2 visible markers were not separated by the tool. H2 at 77 K by a 'high-pressure Automated Sievert's apparatus from Advanced Material Corporation' (no model named; Methods p. 9757); uptake basis not named; degassing, sample mass, H2 purity and free-volume calibration not stated. N content 0.77% (text p. 9758-9759; taken as XPS at.%, as the 1.06% printed for WC-ACHF-1.0% equals the XPS at.% in Fig. 2a); dopant_concentration_at_pct is N; P detected by XPS survey (Fig. 2a), not quantified. BET area and pore volumes shown only in Fig. 3 inset bar chart (not digitized), so surface_area_method = not_reported. Ultramicropores in two sets at 0.50 and 0.56 nm (p. 9761), no single pore diameter. Reconciliation (agent C): this sample's Fig. 4b isotherm (77 K, plotted to about 80 bar) was digitized by neither extraction and is not in these rows.
extractor: v0.1 rows and agent B (claude-opus-5-5), reconciled by C (claude-opus-5-5)

source_location: main p. 9761 (main-07.png), Fig. 4a (77 K, 0-1 bar), series WC-ACHF-2.0% (cyan markers)
notes: archive: HYC-0043_fig4a_WC-ACHF-2.0.json.
